description.value: Dead Magic Zones are areas of space where magic itself has worn thin and ripped asunder. No magic functions, including that which powers ships and Dark Matter engines. Navigation systems fail, life support fizzles out, and engines go silent. However, gnomish ships, which are powered by advanced science, can pilot through these magicless swathes of space and discover the lost worlds within.
Though most Dead Magic Zones are natural, pockets of Dead Magic are also caused by Arcane Warheads, devastating weapons that have ravaged an entire sector of space now called the Warzone.
